note: CP-1 fishing grounds south of Anvil Cay. A ground is a disc of open sea (centre x, z in metres, radius r). The nets work only inside it. Positions are checked against the baked coast by tools/h2d/check_port.py (each is at least 100 m from any land). richness multiplies the kg of every haul; species = [species id, weight] in draw order. Owner B4/E2; provisional.

gnd_pilchard_shallows.name: Pilchard Shallows
gnd_pilchard_shallows.blurb: Pale green water over a sandbank, 0.6 km south-west of the harbour. Sardine shoals all year. The place to learn the nets.

gnd_gannet_bank.name: Gannet Bank
gnd_gannet_bank.blurb: A ridge 0.8 km south-east where gannets dive on the mackerel. Follow the birds.

gnd_kelp_reef.name: Kelp Reef
gnd_kelp_reef.blurb: A drowned forest of kelp 1.2 km out to the south-west. Richer fish, a longer sail.

gnd_blue_drop.name: Blue Drop
gnd_blue_drop.blurb: Where the shelf falls into deep blue water, 1.8 km south. Tuna run here. Too far and too deep to work alone: you need at least one hand aboard.
